verdict.rationale: Firecrawl's outputs (markdown/HTML/structured JSON) are inherently portable formats, and its open-source AGPL-3.0 license means self-hosting/forking is possible, reducing lock-in — but there is no documented feature for exporting job configurations, crawl settings, or webhooks setups for migration to another provider. missing for 10: explicit job-configuration export/import tooling, migration guides, or documented data-portability features beyond raw scrape output formats.
